hero.subhead: Finding it shouldn't be the hardest part.
hero.description: India has government programmes designed to support farmers, students, women, workers, entrepreneurs, and families. Yojana Saathi helps you discover relevant schemes through a simple conversation in your language.
hero.freeNote: Free to use · Speak in Hindi, English, or Bengali

problem.subtitle: India runs one of the world's largest social welfare systems. But navigating it can feel like searching for a needle in a haystack.
problem.p1Desc: Scheme information is spread across multiple government websites, ministries, and departments — making it hard to find everything in one place.
problem.p2Desc: Eligibility criteria involve combinations of age, income, occupation, caste, state, and more. Interpreting these rules can be overwhelming.
problem.p3Desc: Many portals are primarily in English or formal Hindi, creating barriers for citizens who are more comfortable in regional languages or conversational speech.
problem.p4Desc: Citizens may not even be aware that a relevant scheme exists for their circumstances. You can't apply for what you don't know about.

people.subtitle: These illustrative scenarios show how a conversational interface can help different citizens discover relevant government schemes.
people.farmerRole: A farmer looking for agricultural support
people.farmerChallenge: Navigating between state agriculture departments, central PM-KISAN databases, and crop insurance portals can be time-consuming and confusing.
people.farmerHow: Describe your farm, location, and income — discover relevant agricultural schemes.
people.studentChallenge: Scholarship and education loan schemes are spread across UGC, state education departments, and minority welfare boards with different application windows.
people.studentHow: Share your education level, category, and state — find scholarships that may fit.
people.womanChallenge: Women-specific livelihood and entrepreneurship schemes exist across ministries of MSME, rural development, and women & child development — but finding them requires searching each separately.
people.womanHow: Explain your goal, background, and location — see relevant livelihood programmes.
people.workerRole: A worker or family seeking welfare benefits
people.workerChallenge: Welfare schemes for housing, health insurance, pensions, and employment are managed by different departments with varying eligibility thresholds.
people.workerHow: Tell us about your family, income, and occupation — explore available benefits.
people.note: * These are illustrative scenarios, not testimonials. Yojana Saathi helps discover potentially relevant schemes — eligibility and approval are determined by government departments.

solution.subtitle: Yojana Saathi uses AI to turn your spoken or typed description into a structured profile, then matches it against available scheme eligibility information.
solution.step1Desc: Describe your circumstances in Hindi, English, or Bengali. No complex forms to navigate.
solution.step2Desc: Our AI interprets your description and builds a structured profile — which you can review and correct.
solution.step3Desc: Your profile is compared against available scheme eligibility criteria to find potentially matching programmes.
solution.step4Desc: See eligibility details, required documents, benefits, and application steps for each scheme.
solution.step5Desc: Every scheme includes links to official government sources for verification and application.
solution.step6Desc: Bookmark schemes for later and use the chatbot for any follow-up questions about the process.

howItWorks.step1Desc: Describe your circumstances using voice or text, in a supported language.
howItWorks.step2Desc: AI extracts relevant details and presents them for your review and correction.
howItWorks.step3Desc: The platform compares your profile with available scheme eligibility information.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Review requirements, explore benefits, and continue through official government sources.

capabilities.subtitle: Every feature exists to reduce the effort between learning about a scheme and taking the next step toward it.
capabilities.voiceDesc: Start a conversation by speaking — the fastest way to describe complex personal circumstances.
capabilities.langDesc: Interact in the language you are most comfortable with: Hindi, English, or Bengali.
capabilities.profileDesc: Your extracted profile is matched against scheme eligibility criteria — age, income, occupation, state, category, and more.
capabilities.infoDesc: Each scheme shows eligibility criteria, required documents, benefits, and step-by-step application instructions.
capabilities.linksDesc: Every scheme links directly to its official government source — so you can verify information yourself.
capabilities.saveDesc: Bookmark relevant schemes and revisit them when you are ready to start the application process.
capabilities.assistantDesc: Ask questions about any scheme, eligibility requirement, or documentation directly from the floating Saathi assistant on any page.

trust.subtitle: We believe transparency is more valuable than hype. Here's how we approach accuracy and trust.
trust.t1Desc: Every scheme in our database includes a link to its official government source. We encourage you to verify current eligibility criteria directly.
trust.t2Desc: After AI extracts your profile, you can review and edit every field before searching for schemes. You remain in control of your data.
trust.t3Desc: Yojana Saathi helps you discover potentially eligible schemes. Final eligibility and approval is determined by the relevant government department.
trust.t4Desc: Scheme rules can change. We recommend confirming current requirements with the relevant government office before applying.

impact.subtitle: Yojana Saathi is built with the belief that awareness is the first step toward access — and that technology can meaningfully lower the barriers to discovering government support.
impact.i1Desc: Reducing the effort needed to find relevant government programmes — from searching dozens of portals to having one conversation.
impact.i2Desc: Making scheme information explorable in Hindi, English, and Bengali — so language is not a barrier to awareness.
impact.i3Desc: Presenting eligibility rules, required documents, and application steps in a structured, readable format.
impact.i4Desc: Helping citizens learn about support programmes they may not have known existed for their specific circumstances.
impact.i5Desc: Making digital public service information easier to navigate — especially for those less familiar with complex government portals.

finalCta.desc: Start with your story. Discover the schemes that may fit your circumstances.

footer.desc: AI-powered government scheme discovery. Helping Indian citizens find relevant welfare schemes through simple conversations.
footer.disclaimer: Yojana Saathi is a technology platform that helps discover potentially relevant government schemes. Eligibility and final approval are subject to official scheme rules and government verification. Information may not reflect the most recent changes. Always verify with the relevant government department.
